notes.title: New Game release!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce our new release:

Invisible Places - Pixel Art Jigsaw Puzzle

This new game is a spiritual successor to our first Jigsaw puzzle.
This new game had 2 goals:

 Honor the family of one of our team members.
 Increase our contact with our followers.


The first objective was successfully accomplished!
The second, we want to hear your opinion! In all of our games there are tabs in the Community Center so you can tell us about bugs, issues or recommendations.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807500/Invisible_Places__Pixel_Art_Jigsaw_Puzzle/

Thanks for your attention <3

notes.title: Definitive version
notes.notes:
Yes, we've made some updates to Invisible Services - Pixel art Jigsaw Puzzle!

 Bug fixes
 Project Optimization.
 Sound improvements.

Improvements that are evident in FPS gains and stability.

We are happy to bring these updates to you.
Don't forget to follow us on our social media and let us know what you think of the updates in the Community Center.

A safe hug for each one ♥

notes.title: Small Update! v3.0
notes.notes:
In this version, visual feedback was added when the piece is fitted in place!
 The audible feedback of when a piece is picked up and another for when the piece is released have been modified.
 There was a problem saving the game sounds. This problem has also been solved!
 Some users felt that the pieces moved very slowly in relation to the mouse, we did a test with a focus group and we arrived at new values, we hope it will please you.
 Some achievements had a long wait to be called, we made changes to that.


We hope this contributes to your experience!
Make sure you follow our Studio developer page, so you can always stay on top of new games and news.

Enjoy this relaxing experience.
Make sure to tell us what you think! Our social networks or our Community Center!
